purpose: Compose existing width/rail operations while preventing unsupported numeric width fallback from becoming measured evidence.
runtime: Node >=24; standard library and bundled exact sources only; no network, Git checkout, dependencies or production writes

inputs.raster: RGBA plus width/height, canonical image identity and explicit same-image frame; nominal fixture argument and actual occupied rows kept separately
inputs.segments: Independently qualified straight tee-to-badge segments with endpoint uncertainty; empty, short, covered or ambiguous segments remain conditions
inputs.ownership: Explicit known-occluder masks/boxes in that same frame; no new AA suppression
inputs.candidateWidths: Finite positive full ribbon widths in same-image pixels; no meter-scale inference or unqualified default
inputs.confidencePolicy: Caller-declared minimum qualified segments, bilateral/visible sample counts, mean score, candidate score separation and maximum relative width IQR; no built-in scientific acceptance thresholds
inputs.confidenceEvidence: Local image scope, independent qualification, bilateral counts, width spread, profile-boundary status and held-out agreement within reported fit uncertainty

stages.output: verified source IDs; mismatch stops as integrity failure
nominal argument, occupied rows and bilinear edge separation in pixels
left/right/midpoint/full-width and lum-per-pixel edge strength, or no pair
stages.eligibility: record finite search extent and center gate; explicit wider gate is an experiment variant

stages.output: rail/inner channels, visibility, railMode and combined score
stages.eligibility: paired calibration evidence needs both visible rails; combined interior-only score is retained but insufficient

stages.output: legacy width and all candidate scores/counts with explicit nonfinite tags; never consume numerical fallback alone
UNKNOWN with widthPx null and reason, or ELIGIBLE_FOR_COMPARISON with source width and score separation; promoted false always

stages.call: future owner-supplied frozen baseline versus qualified-width variant
stages.output: independent held-out widths, center residuals, source/frame identities and failures
stages.eligibility: requires real visible segment evidence; this synthetic pack does not run or claim it

outputs: machine receipt with per-case arguments/results/interpretation and source+code SHA provenance
no promoted candidate or changed default
evidenceChecks: actual raster rows distinguish nominal argument from fitted width
near-boundary weak fit stays a counterexample
default gate rejection is tested against explicit wider gate
zero fixed-pose sensor score does not imply ribbon absence
rail UNKNOWN and combined score may coexist
all-hidden and empty segments never become measured numeric width
missing policy, tied score, missing bilateral/held-out evidence and boundary ambiguity yield UNKNOWN
UNKNOWN: unreported fit uncertainty or held-out comparison

boundaries.meterScale: rings only; local width never calibrates meters
boundaries.AA: unchanged; suppression waits full S7 baseline
boundaries.integration: owner copies pack; experiments remain separate from production CV
